ayahs.1: Yeh hai woh surat jo hum ne naazil farmaayi hai aur muqarrar kar di hai aur jis mein hum ne khuli aayaten (ahkaam) utaare hain taake tum yaad rakho.
ayahs.2: Zinakar aurat-o-mard mein se har ek ko sau kode lagaao. Un par Allah ki shariat ki hadd jaari karte hue tumhein hargiz taras na khaana chaahiye, agar tumhein Allah par aur qayamat ke din par imaan ho. Un ki saza ke waqt musalmanon ki ek jamaat maujood honi chaahiye.
ayahs.3: Zaani mard bajuz zaaniya ya mushrika aurat ke aur se nikah nahin karta aur zinaakaar aurat bhi bajuz zaani ya mushrik mard ke aur se nikah nahin karti aur imaan walon par yeh haraam kar diya gaya.
ayahs.4: Jo log paak-daaman auraton par zina ki tohmat lagaayen phir chaar gawaah na pesh kar saken to unhein assi kode lagaao aur kabhi bhi un ki gawaahi qubool na karo. Yeh faasiq log hain.
ayahs.5: Haan jo log is ke baad tauba aur islaah kar len to Allah Taala bakhshne wala aur mehrbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.6: Jo log apni biwiyon par badkaari ki tohmat laayen aur un ka koi gawaah bajuz khud un ki zaat ke na ho to aise logon mein se har ek ka saboot yeh hai ke chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha kar kahen ke woh sachchon mein se hain.
ayahs.7: Aur paanchwin martaba kahe ke is par Allah Taala ki laanat ho agar woh jhooton mein se ho.
ayahs.8: Aur is aurat se saza is tarah door ho sakti hai ke woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam kha kar kahe ke yaqeenan is ka mard jhoot bolne walon mein se hai.
ayahs.9: Aur paanchwin dafa kahe ke is par Allah Taala ka ghazab ho agar is ka khaawind sachchon mein se ho.
ayahs.10: Agar Allah Taala ka fazl-o-karam tum par na hota (to tum par mashaqqat utarti) aur Allah Taala tauba qubool karne wala ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.11: Jo log yeh bahut bada bohtan baandh laaye hain yeh bhi tum mein se hi ek giroh hai. Tum ise apne liye bura na samjho, balke yeh to tumhare haq mein behtar hai. Haan in mein se har ek shakhs par itna gunaah hai jitna is ne kamaaya hai aur in mein se jis ne is ke bahut bade hisse ko sar-anjaam diya hai is ke liye azaab bhi bahut hi bada hai.
ayahs.12: Ise sunte hi momin mardon auraton ne apne haq mein nek gumaani kyun na ki aur kyun na keh diya ke yeh to khullam-khulla sareeh bohtan hai.
ayahs.13: Woh is par chaar gawaah kyun na laaye? Aur jab gawaah nahin laaye to yeh bohtan-baaz log yaqeenan Allah ke nazdeek mehaz jhoote hain.
ayahs.14: Agar Allah Taala ka fazl-o-karam tum par dunya aur aakhirat mein na hota to yaqeenan tum ne jis baat ke charche shuru kar rakhe the is baare mein tumhein bahut bada azaab pahunchta.
ayahs.15: Jab ke tum ise apni zabanon se naql-dar-naql karne lage aur apne munh se woh baat nikaalne lage jis ki tumhein mutlaq khabar na thi, go tum ise halki baat samajhte rahe lekin Allah Taala ke nazdeek woh bahut badi baat thi.
ayahs.16: Tum ne aisi baat ko sunte hi kyun na keh diya ke hamein aisi baat munh se nikaalni bhi laaiq nahin. Ya Allah! Tu paak hai, yeh to bahut bada bohtan hai aur tohmat hai.
ayahs.17: Allah Taala tumhein naseehat karta hai ke phir kabhi bhi aisa kaam na karna agar tum sachche momin ho.
ayahs.18: Allah Taala tumhare saamne apni aayaten bayan farma raha hai, aur Allah Taala ilm-o-hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.19: Jo log musalmanon mein be-hayaai phailaane ke aarzoo-mand rehte hain un ke liye dunya aur aakhirat mein dardnaak azaab hain, Allah sab kuchh jaanta hai aur tum kuchh bhi nahin jaante.
ayahs.20: Agar tum par Allah ka fazl aur is ki rehmat na hoti aur yeh bhi ke Allah Taala badi shafqat rakhne wala mehrbaan hai. (To tum par azaab utar jaata).
ayahs.21: Imaan walo! Shaytaan ke qadam-ba-qadam na chalo. Jo shakhs shaytaani qadmon ki pairwi kare to woh to be-hayaai aur bure kaamon ka hi hukm karega. Aur agar Allah Taala ka fazl-o-karam tum par na hota to tum mein se koi kabhi bhi paak saaf na hota. Lekin Allah Taala jise paak karna chaahe, kar deta hai. Aur Allah sab sunne wala sab jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.22: Tum mein se jo buzurgi aur kushadgi wale hain unhein apne qarabat-daron aur miskeenon aur muhajiron ko fi sabeelillah dene se qasam na kha leni chaahiye, balke maaf kar dena aur darguzar kar lena chaahiye. Kya tum nahin chaahte ke Allah Taala tumhare qusoor maaf farma de? Allah qusooron ko maaf farmaane wala mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.23: Jo log paak-daaman bholi-bhaali ba-imaan auraton par tohmat lagaate hain woh dunya-o-aakhirat mein maloon hain aur un ke liye bada bhaari azaab hai.
ayahs.24: Jab ke un ke muqaable mein un ki zabanen aur un ke haath paaon un ke aamaal ki gawaahi denge.
ayahs.25: Is din Allah Taala unhein poora poora badla haq-o-insaaf ke saath dega aur woh jaan lenge ke Allah Taala hi haq hai (aur wahi) zaahir karne wala hai.
ayahs.26: Khabees auraten khabees mardon ke laaiq hain aur khabees mard khabees auraton ke laaiq hain aur paak auraten paak mardon ke laaiq hain aur paak mard paak auraton ke laaiq hain. Aise paak logon ke mutalliq jo kuchh bakwaas (bohtan-baaz) kar rahe hain woh in se bilkul bari hain, un ke liye bakhshish hai aur izzat wali rozi.
ayahs.27: Aye imaan walo! Apne gharon ke siwa aur gharon mein na jaao jab tak ke ijaazat na le lo aur wahan ke rehne walon ko salaam na kar lo, yehi tumhare liye sarasar behtar hai taake tum naseehat haasil karo.
ayahs.28: Agar wahan tumhein koi bhi na mil sake to phir ijaazat mile baghair andar na jaao. Agar tum se laut jaane ko kaha jaaye to tum laut hi jaao, yehi baat tumhare liye pakeeza hai, jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho Allah Taala khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.29: Haan ghair-aabad gharon mein jahan tumhara koi faaida ya asbaab ho, jaane mein tum par koi gunaah nahin. Tum jo kuchh bhi zaahir karte ho aur jo chhupaate ho Allah Taala sab kuchh jaanta hai.
ayahs.30: Musalman mardon se kaho ke apni nigaahen neechi rakhen, aur apni sharmgaahon ki hifaazat rakhen. Yehi un ke liye pakeezgi hai, log jo kuchh karen Allah Taala sab se khabardaar hai.
ayahs.31: Musalman auraton se kaho ke woh bhi apni nigaahen neechi rakhen aur apni ismat mein farq na aane den aur apni zeenat ko zaahir na karen, siwaaye is ke jo zaahir hai aur apne garebaanon par apni odhniyan daale rahen, aur apni aaraish ko kisi ke saamne zaahir na karen, siwaaye apne khaawindon ke ya apne waalid ke ya apne khusr ke ya apne ladkon ke ya apne khaawind ke ladkon ke ya apne bhaiyon ke ya apne bhatijon ke ya apne bhanjon ke ya apne mel-jol ki auraton ke ya ghulamon ke ya aise naukar-chaakar mardon ke jo shahwat wale na hon ya aise bachchon ke jo auraton ke parde ki baaton se muttala nahin. Aur is tarah zor zor se paaon maar kar na chalen ke un ki posheeda zeenat maloom ho jaaye, aye musalmano! Tum sab ke sab Allah ki janaab mein tauba karo taake tum najaat paao.
ayahs.32: Tum mein se jo mard aurat be-nikah ke hon un ka nikah kar do aur apne nek-bakht ghulam aur laundiyon ka bhi. Agar woh muflis bhi honge to Allah Taala unhein apne fazl se ghani bana dega. Allah Taala kushadgi wala aur ilm wala hai.
ayahs.33: Aur in logon ko paak-daaman rehna chaahiye jo apna nikah karne ka maqdoor nahin rakhte yahan tak ke Allah Taala unhein apne fazl se maaldaar bana de, tumhare ghulamon mein jo koi kuchh tumhein de kar azaadi ki tehreer karaani chaahe to tum aisi tehreer unhein kar diya karo agar tum ko in mein koi bhalaai nazar aati ho. Aur Allah ne jo maal tumhein de rakha hai is mein se unhein bhi do, tumhari jo laundiyan paak-daaman rehna chaahti hain unhein dunya ki zindagi ke faaide ki gharz se badkaari par majboor na karo aur jo unhein majboor kar de to Allah Taala un par jabr ke baad bakhshish dene wala aur mehrbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.34: Hum ne tumhari taraf khuli aur roshan aayaten utaar di hain aur in logon ki kahaawaten jo tum se pehle guzar chuke hain aur parhezgaron ke liye naseehat.
ayahs.35: Allah noor hai aasmanon aur zameen ka, is ke noor ki misaal misl ek taaq ke hai jis mein chiraagh ho aur chiraagh sheesha ki qandeel mein ho aur sheesha misl chamakte hue roshan sitaare ke ho woh chiraagh ek ba-barkat darakht zaitoon ke tel se jalaaya jaata ho jo darakht na mashriqi hai na maghribi khud woh tel qareeb hai ke aap hi roshni dene lage agarche ise aag na bhi chhuye, noor par noor hai, Allah Taala apne noor ki taraf rehnumaai karta hai jise chaahe, logon (ke samjhaane) ko yeh misaalen Allah Taala bayan farma raha hai, aur Allah Taala har cheez ke haal se ba-khoobi waaqif hai.
ayahs.36: In gharon mein jin ke buland karne, aur jin mein apne naam ki yaad ka Allah Taala ne hukm diya hai wahan subah-o-shaam Allah Taala ki tasbeeh bayan karte hain.
ayahs.37: Aise log jinhein tijaarat aur khareed-o-farokht Allah ke zikr se aur namaz ke qaaim karne aur zakaat ada karne se ghaafil nahin karti is din se darte hain jis din bahut se dil aur bahut si aankhen ulat-pulat ho jaayengi.
ayahs.38: Is iraade se ke Allah unhein un ke aamaal ka behtareen badle de balke apne fazl se aur kuchh ziyaadati ata farmaaye. Allah Taala jise chaahe be-shumaar roziyan deta hai.
ayahs.39: Aur kaafiron ke aamaal misl is chamakti hui ret ke hain jo chatiyal maidan mein ho jise pyaasa shakhs door se paani samajhta hai lekin jab is ke paas pahunchta hai to ise kuchh bhi nahin paata, haan Allah ko apne paas paata hai jo is ka hisaab poora poora chuka deta hai. Allah bahut jald hisaab kar dene wala hai.
ayahs.40: Ya misl in andheron ke hai jo nihayat gehre samundar ki teh mein hon jise oopar tale ki maujon ne dhaanp rakha ho, phir oopar se baadal chhaaye hue hon. Al-gharz andheriyan hain jo oopar tale pe-dar-pe hain. Jab apna haath nikaale to ise bhi qareeb hai ke na dekh sake, aur (baat yeh hai ke) jise Allah Taala hi noor na de is ke paas koi roshni nahin hoti.
ayahs.41: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke aasmanon aur zameen ki kul makhlooq aur par phailaaye udne wale kul parind Allah ki tasbeeh mein mashghool hain. Har ek ki namaz aur tasbeeh ise maloom hai, log jo kuchh karen is se Allah ba-khoobi waaqif hai.
ayahs.42: Zameen-o-aasman ki baadshahat Allah hi ki hai aur Allah Taala hi ki taraf lautna hai.
ayahs.43: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke Allah Taala baadalon ko chalaata hai, phir unhein milaata hai phir unhein teh-ba-teh kar deta hai, phir aap dekhte hain ke un ke darmiyaan mein se meenh barasta hai. Wahi aasman ki jaanib se oolon ke pahaad mein se oole barsaata hai, phir jinhein chaahe un ke paas unhein barsaaye aur jin se chaahe un se unhein hata de. Baadal hi se nikalne wali bijli ki chamak aisi hoti hai ke goya ab aankhon ki roshni le chali.
ayahs.44: Allah Taala hi din aur raat ko radd-o-badal karta rehta hai aankhon walon ke liye to is mein yaqeenan badi badi ibraten hain.
ayahs.45: Tamaam ke tamaam chalne phirne wale jaandaaron ko Allah Taala hi ne paani se paida kiya hai in mein se baaz to apne pet ke bal chalte hain, baaz do paaon par chalte hain. Baaz chaar paaon par chalte hain, Allah Taala jo chaahta hai paida karta hai. Be-shak Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.46: Bila-shak-o-shubha hum ne roshan aur waazeh aayaten utaar di hain Allah Taala jise chaahe seedhi raah dikha deta hai.
ayahs.47: Aur kehte hain ke hum Allah Taala aur Rasool par imaan laaye aur farmaan-bardaar hue, phir in mein se ek firqa is ke baad bhi phir jaata hai. Yeh imaan wale hain (hi) nahin.
ayahs.48: Jab yeh is baat ki taraf bulaaye jaate hain ke Allah aur is ka Rasool un ke jhagde chuka de to bhi un ki ek jamaat munh modne wali ban jaati hai.
ayahs.49: Haan agar in hi ko haq pahunchta ho to mutee-o-farmaan-bardaar ho kar is ki taraf chale aate hain.
ayahs.50: Kya in ke dilon mein bimaari hai? Ya yeh shak-o-shubha mein pade hue hain? Ya unhein is baat ka dar hai ke Allah Taala aur is ka Rasool un ki haq-talafi na karen? Baat yeh hai ke yeh log khud hi bade zaalim hain.
ayahs.51: Imaan walon ka qaul to yeh hai ke jab unhein is liye bulaaya jaata hai ke Allah aur is ka Rasool in mein faisla kar de to woh kehte hain ke hum ne suna aur maan liya. Yehi log kaamyaab hone wale hain.
ayahs.52: Jo bhi Allah Taala ki, is ke Rasool ki farmaan-bardari karen, khauf-e-Ilahi rakhen aur is ke azaabon se darte rahen, wohi najaat paane wale hain.
ayahs.53: Badi pukhtagi ke saath Allah Taala ki qasmen kha kha kar kehte hain ke aap ka hukm hote hi nikal khade honge. Keh dijiye ke bas qasmen na khaao (tumhari) itaat (ki haqeeqat) maloom hai. Jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho Allah Taala is se ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.54: Keh dijiye ke Allah Taala ka hukm maano, Rasoolullah ki itaat karo, phir bhi agar tum ne roogardani ki to Rasool ke zimme to sirf wahi hai jo is par laazim kar diya gaya hai aur tum par is ki jawaabdehi hai jo tum par rakha gaya hai hidayat to tumhein isi waqt milegi jab Rasool ki matahati karo. Suno Rasool ke zimme to sirf saaf taur par pahuncha dena hai.
ayahs.55: Tum mein se in logon se jo imaan laaye hain aur nek aamaal kiye hain Allah Taala wada farma chuka hai ke unhein zaroor zameen mein khalifa banaayega jaise ke in logon ko khalifa banaaya tha jo in se pehle the aur yaqeenan un ke liye un ke is deen ko mazbooti ke saath muhkam kar ke jama dega jise un ke liye woh pasand farma chuka hai aur un ke is khauf-o-khatar ko woh aman-o-amaan se badal dega, woh meri ibaadat karenge mere saath kisi ko bhi shareek na thehraayenge. Is ke baad bhi jo log na-shukri aur kufr karen woh yaqeenan faasiq hain.
ayahs.56: Namaz ki paabandi karo, zakaat ada karo aur Allah Taala ke Rasool ki farmaan-bardari mein lage raho taake tum par rahm kiya jaaye.
ayahs.57: Yeh khayal aap kabhi bhi na karna ke munkir log zameen mein (idhar udhar bhaag kar) hamein hara dene wale hain, un ka asli thikaana to jahannam hai jo yaqeenan bahut hi bura thikaana hai.
ayahs.58: Imaan walo! Tum se tumhari milkiyat ke ghulamon ko aur unhein bhi jo tum mein se bulughat ko na pahunche hon (apne aane ki) teen waqton mein ijaazat haasil karni zaroori hai. Namaz-e-fajr se pehle aur zuhr ke waqt jab ke tum apne kapde utaar rakhte ho aur isha ki namaz ke baad, yeh teenon waqt tumhari (khalwat) aur parde ke hain. In waqton ke ma-siwa na to tum par koi gunaah hai na un par. Tum sab aapas mein ek doosre ke paas ba-kasrat aane jaane wale ho (hi), Allah isi tarah khol khol kar apne ahkaam tum se bayan farma raha hai. Allah Taala poore ilm aur kaamil hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.59: Aur tumhare bachche (bhi) jab bulughat ko pahunch jaayen to jis tarah un ke agle log ijaazat maangte hain unhein bhi ijaazat maang kar aana chaahiye, Allah Taala tum se isi tarah apni aayaten bayan farmaata hai. Allah Taala hi ilm-o-hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.60: Badi boodhi auraten jinhein nikah ki umeed (aur khwahish hi) na rahi ho woh agar apne kapde utaar rakhen to un par koi gunaah nahin bashartike woh apna banaao-singhaar zaahir karne waliyan na hon, taaham agar un se bhi ihtiyaat rakhen to un ke liye bahut afzal hai, aur Allah Taala sunta jaanta hai.
ayahs.61: Andhe par, langde par, bimaar par aur khud tum par (mutlaqan) koi harj nahin ke tum apne gharon se kha lo ya apne baapon ke gharon se ya apni maaon ke gharon se ya apne bhaiyon ke gharon se ya apni behnon ke gharon se ya apne chachaon ke gharon se ya apni phuphiyon ke gharon se ya apne mamuon ke gharon se ya apni khalaon ke gharon se ya in gharon se jin ki kunjiyon ke tum maalik ho ya apne doston ke gharon se. Tum par is mein bhi koi gunaah nahin ke tum sab saath baith kar khaana khaao ya alag alag pas jab tum gharon mein jaane lago to apne ghar walon ko salaam kar liya karo dua-e-khair hai jo ba-barkat aur pakeeza hai Allah Taala ki taraf se naazil-shuda, yun hi Allah Taala khol khol kar tum se apne ahkaam bayan farma raha hai taake tum samajh lo.
ayahs.62: Ba-imaan log to wohi hain jo Allah Taala par aur is ke Rasool par yaqeen rakhte hain aur jab aise muamle mein jis mein logon ke jama hone ki zaroorat hoti hai Nabi ke saath hote hain to jab tak aap se ijaazat na len kahin nahin jaate. Jo log aise mauqe par aap se ijaazat le lete hain haqeeqat mein yehi hain woh jo Allah Taala par aur is ke Rasool par imaan la chuke hain. Pas jab aise log aap se apne kisi kaam ke liye ijaazat talab karen to aap in mein se jise chaahen ijaazat de den aur in ke liye Allah Taala se bakhshish ki dua maangen, be-shak Allah bakhshne wala mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.63: Tum Allah Taala ke Nabi ke bulaane ko aisa bulaawa na kar lo jaisa ke aapas mein ek doosre ko hota hai. Tum mein se unhein Allah khoob jaanta hai jo nazar bacha kar chupke se sarak jaate hain. Suno jo log hukm-e-Rasool ki mukhalifat karte hain unhein darte rehna chaahiye ke kahin un par koi zabardast aafat na aa pade ya unhein dardnaak azaab na pahunche.
ayahs.64: Aagaah ho jaao ke aasman-o-zameen mein jo kuchh hai sab Allah Taala hi ka hai. Jis rawish par tum ho woh ise ba-khoobi jaanta hai, aur jis din yeh sab is ki taraf lautaaye jaayenge is din in ko un ke kiye se woh khabardaar kar dega. Allah Taala sab kuchh jaanne wala hai.
